from hypothesis import given, strategies as st

from vllm_mlx.reasoning.gemma4_parser import Gemma4ReasoningParser

THOUGHT_OPEN = "<|channel>thought\n"
CLOSE = "<channel|>"
CONTENT_OPEN = "<|channel>content\n"
TURN_END = "<turn|>"


def _run(deltas):
    """Feed deltas through a fresh parser; return (reasoning, content, msgs)."""
    parser = Gemma4ReasoningParser()
    prev = ""
    reasoning, content, msgs = "", "", []
    for d in deltas:
        cur = prev + d
        msg = parser.extract_reasoning_streaming(prev, cur, d)
        prev = cur
        msgs.append(msg)
        if msg is not None:
            reasoning += msg.reasoning or ""
            content += msg.content or ""
    return reasoning, content, msgs


def test_issue_example_delta_straddling_close_splits_reasoning_and_content():
    """A delta holding the end of thought, the close marker and the start of content routes each part to its own channel."""
    parser = Gemma4ReasoningParser()
    previous = "<|channel>thoughtthinking..."
    delta = " final thought<channel|><|channel>contentHello"
    current = previous + delta
    parser.extract_reasoning_streaming("", previous, previous)
    msg = parser.extract_reasoning_streaming(previous, current, delta)
    assert msg.reasoning == " final thought"
    assert msg.content == "Hello"


def test_straddling_delta_yields_one_message_with_both_fields():
    """A delta that ends reasoning and starts content produces a single DeltaMessage with both reasoning and content set."""
    r, c, msgs = _run(
        [
            THOUGHT_OPEN + "step one",
            ". Wyoming (WY)" + CLOSE + CONTENT_OPEN + "1. Alabama (AL)",
        ]
    )
    last = msgs[-1]
    assert last is not None
    assert last.reasoning == ". Wyoming (WY)"
    assert last.content == "1. Alabama (AL)"
    assert r == "step one. Wyoming (WY)"
    assert c == "1. Alabama (AL)"


def test_trailing_reasoning_bytes_do_not_leak_into_content():
    """Reasoning bytes that arrive in the same delta before the close marker never appear in content."""
    r, c, _ = _run([THOUGHT_OPEN + "abc", "tail" + CLOSE + CONTENT_OPEN + "answer"])
    assert "tail" not in c
    assert c == "answer"
    assert r == "abctail"


def test_delta_with_several_markers_is_processed_in_order():
    """A single delta with thought end, content start and turn end routes every segment to its own channel."""
    delta = THOUGHT_OPEN + "think" + CLOSE + CONTENT_OPEN + "answer" + CLOSE + TURN_END
    r, c, _ = _run([delta])
    assert r == "think"
    assert c == "answer"


def test_whole_stream_in_one_delta_matches_split_stream():
    """Delivering a whole response as one delta gives the same reasoning and content as delivering it in small pieces."""
    full = THOUGHT_OPEN + "ponder" + CLOSE + CONTENT_OPEN + "reply" + CLOSE
    r1, c1, _ = _run([full])
    r2, c2, _ = _run(
        [THOUGHT_OPEN, "pon", "der", CLOSE, CONTENT_OPEN, "re", "ply", CLOSE]
    )
    assert (r1, c1) == (r2, c2) == ("ponder", "reply")


def test_pure_content_without_channels_stays_content():
    """Plain text with no channel markers is routed to content."""
    r, c, _ = _run(["Hello ", "world"])
    assert r == ""
    assert c == "Hello world"


_text = st.text(alphabet="abcxyz .()0123", min_size=1, max_size=30)


@given(
    reasoning=_text,
    content=_text,
    data=st.data(),
)
def test_any_grouping_of_tokens_reassembles_to_same_channels(reasoning, content, data):
    """However the stream's pieces are batched into deltas, the reassembled reasoning and content equal the original reasoning and content."""
    atoms = [THOUGHT_OPEN]
    atoms += list(reasoning)
    atoms += [CLOSE, CONTENT_OPEN]
    atoms += list(content)
    atoms += [CLOSE]
    deltas, cur = [], ""
    for a in atoms:

        if data.draw(st.booleans()):
            deltas.append(cur)
            cur = ""
    if cur:
        deltas.append(cur)
    r, c, _ = _run(deltas)
    assert r == reasoning
    assert c == content


@given(reasoning=_text, content=_text)
def test_streamed_content_matches_nonstreamed_content(reasoning, content):
    """Streamed content, reassembled, equals the content from non-streaming extraction of the same output."""
    full = THOUGHT_OPEN + reasoning + CLOSE + CONTENT_OPEN + content + CLOSE
    _, streamed_content, _ = _run([full])
    _, expected = Gemma4ReasoningParser().extract_reasoning(full)
    assert streamed_content.strip() == (expected or "").strip()
